role: One entry in the client's map of blocks being destroyed by a player: the position, the 1-10 crack stage and the tick it was last updated, drawn by RenderGlobal's damage overlay.

members.name: miningPlayerEntId
members.note: one player per scenario; no per-player map

members.name: partialBlockProgress
members.note: computed as (int)(cur_damage * 10) - 1 from the dig state instead of stored from S25

members.name: createdAtCloudUpdateTick
members.note: stale-progress bookkeeping is not modelled; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: setPartialBlockDamage
members.note: the stage comes from the client's own dig progress, not the S25 payload

notes: The visible result is gated: the particles_dig render scene carries the destroy-progress crack (csrc/tests/render_budget.txt note at the particles_dig line). Multi-player destroy-progress packets are not modelled. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): only observable by a second player; the env is single player. Formerly listed as missing: The S25PacketBlockBreakAnim-driven per-player map in RenderGlobal is unported; the crack stage is computed from the local dig flow (survival.c:surv_client_dig_stage) and drawn by raster_overlay.c:crack.
